module Test.WHL.04

function bad_invariant(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n > 0
is
    let x: Integer = n
    while x >= 0
    invariant x > 0
    variant x
    do
        x := x - 1
    end while
    return x
end bad_invariant

end Test.WHL.04
